map.根据材料类型和使用环境（温度、湿度），综合评估耐磨等级和环保性评分: From material type and service environment (temperature, humidity), comprehensively assess the wear-resistance grade and eco-friendliness score.
map.环保耐磨综合评估：基于材料类型、工作环境温度/湿度与耐磨性能指标，参照环保与耐磨: Eco wear-resistance assessment: based on material type, service temperature / humidity, and wear-performance indicators, with reference to eco and wear standards via weighted grading, for green material selection and improvement.
map.💡 综合评分 = 耐磨评分(50%) + 环保评分(30%) + 环境适应性(2: 💡 Composite score = wear score (50%) + eco score (30%) + environmental-adaptability (20%). Temperature and humidity apply correction effects on wear and eco scores.
map.耐磨评分基于材料硬度和自润滑性，环保评分基于可回收性和毒性: The wear score is based on hardness and self-lubricity; the eco score on recyclability and toxicity.
map.高温环境（>200℃）会降低多数材料的耐磨性和部分材料的环保性: High-temperature environments (>200°C) reduce the wear resistance of most materials and the eco score of some.
map.高湿度环境（>70%）会加速碳钢和铝合金的腐蚀磨损: High-humidity environments (>70%) accelerate corrosion wear of carbon steel and aluminum alloy.
map.本评估为定性参考，实际选材需结合工程实验数据: This assessment is a qualitative reference; actual selection needs engineering test data.
map.📚 深度解析：环保耐磨评估（温度/湿度对材料评分的影响）: 📚 Deep Dive: Eco Wear-Resistance Assessment (temperature / humidity effects on material scores)
map.绿色选材：输入材料类型、工作温度与湿度，综合评估耐磨与环保评分: Green selection: enter material type, working temperature, and humidity to assess wear and eco scores comprehensively.
map.工况校核：温度超出材料推荐区间时看耐磨分下降多少: Duty check: when temperature exceeds the recommended range, see how much the wear score drops.
map.高湿环境：湿度对碳钢等易锈材料影响显著，需提前识别: High-humidity environment: humidity strongly affects rust-prone materials like carbon steel; identify early.
map.算法：温度惩罚 = 低于下限取 min(20,(下限−温度)×0.1)，高于上限: Algorithm: temperature penalty = below lower limit take min(20,(lower−temp)×0.1), above upper limit take min(30,(temp−upper)×0.05); humidity penalty = max(0, humidity−50) × material humidity coefficient × 0.1; wear score = clamp(10,100, material wear base − temp penalty − humidity penalty); eco score = material eco base (plastic −10 if >300°C, −15 more if >500°C); adaptability = max(20, 100 − temp penalty×1.5 − humidity penalty×1.2); composite = wear×0.5 + eco×0.3 + adaptability×0.2; ≥90 A, ≥80 B, ≥70 C, ≥60 D, else E.
map.例：碳钢（45钢，耐磨基数 65、环保 55、适用 −20~200℃、湿度系数: Example: carbon steel (45#, wear base 65, eco 55, range −20~200°C, humidity coefficient 0.6) at 250°C/75%RH → temp penalty 2.5, humidity penalty 1.5, wear 61.0 (D fair), eco 55.0 (E poor), adaptability 94.45, composite 65.89 (D fair). Switch to 304 stainless (wear 78, eco 85, coefficient 0.15) at 25°C/65%RH → temp penalty 0, humidity penalty 0.225, wear 77.78 (C medium), eco 85.0 (B good), composite 84.33 (B good).
map.湿度惩罚为什么和材料有关？: Why does the humidity penalty depend on material?
map.不同材料吸湿与锈蚀敏感性差异大：碳钢湿度系数 0.6，304 不锈钢仅 0.15: Materials differ greatly in moisture absorption and corrosion sensitivity: carbon steel coefficient 0.6, 304 stainless only 0.15, carbide 0.1. In high humidity, switching to stainless or adding anti-rust coating gains far more than internal selection among ordinary materials.
map.综合分权重可以改吗？: Can the composite-score weights be changed?
map.工具固定为耐磨 0.5、环保 0.3、适配 0.2，偏向耐磨主导的工况；若项目以: The tool fixes wear 0.5, eco 0.3, adaptability 0.2, biased toward wear-dominant duties; if a project prioritizes eco compliance, recompute the weighted three-dimensional score yourself.
map.环保耐磨评估工具，通过输入材料类型和使用环境参数（温度、湿度），综合评估材料的耐: The eco wear-resistance assessment tool, by material type and service environment parameters (temperature, humidity), comprehensively evaluates the material's wear grade, eco-friendliness score, and environmental adaptability, helping engineers balance performance and eco-friendliness in material selection. Runs in the browser, no data uploaded.
